Hard Money Loans in Tampa, Florida

We found 50 search results for hard money lenders operating in Tampa, FL. The average note made is approximately $278,421. Interest rates on hard money loans issued to Tampa investors average around 12.6%. The typical length for notes is 53 months. The mean origination for the loans is 4.1 points. 72% is the average loan-to-value (LTV) for offered by lenders in Tampa.

Loan Example 1

Blanche closes on a $280,000 renovation project in the Downtown area of Tampa, FL, using a hard money loan from River City Funding Group. Since the lender agrees to a 60% loan-to-value, Blanche will need to put 40% down so the principle amount of the note will be $168,000. The terms of the deal dictate a 10% note for 12 months. They also stipulate a 3 point origination fee, that will also need to be paid when the property closes.

On top of the $5,040 origination fee, Blanche will also fund $112,000 of the purchase with her own cash, or 40% of the sales price. After the deal closes, she will pay River City Funding Group $1,400 in monthly interest fees, or 10% multiplied times $168,000 divided by 12 months in the year. Blanche's plan is to finish the house within the 12 months and resell it for $392,000. If she succeeds she will collect a profit of $90,160 ($392,000 price - $168,000 principle - $112,000 down payment - $5,040 origination points - $16,800 in total interest payments.

Loan Example 2

Fair View Lending makes a loan to Jewell for a rehab project in the Seminole Heights area of Tampa, FL. The deal includes the following:

$290,000 purchase price
85% loan-to-value (LTV)
18 month term
13% rate of interest
1% origination fee

Jewell plans to list the house at the end of the term for $348,000. If she succeeds, the deal numbers would be the following:

$348,000 sales price
- $246,500 note principle (85% LTV)
- $43,500 down payment (15% on 85% LTV)
- $2,465 origination fee (1% of the $246,500 principle)
- $48,068 total interest paid (18 months x 13% interest)
-----------------------
= $7,468 total profit (does not include taxes or renovation costs)
